statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ ∃ a : Fin 6 → ℕ, N = p + q + ∑ i : Fin 6, 2 ^ (a i + 1) ∧ ((∑ i : Fin 6, (2 : ℕ) ^ (a i + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ε

plain_statement.zh: 把六幂偏移的总和压进任意固定的 N^ε 窗口，对每个充分大偶数成立。
plain_statement.en: Place the entire six-power correction inside N^ε for every fixed positive ε and every sufficiently large even N.

brief.zh: 本题保留定理 1.1 的六项并限制总偏移。因此每个大偶数 N 左侧的短区间内都要有一个二素数和，而且其距离具有六幂结构。应先将二幂和截到 ε log₂ N 的长度，在这个新长度下分别重算大值集和反射积分的损失。阈值可依赖 ε。
brief.en: Retain six terms but constrain their sum. A Goldbach number must lie just below every even N at a distance with six-term binary structure. Truncate the lacunary sum at a length proportional to ε log₂ N and reassess the large-value and reflection losses. The threshold may depend on ε.
